senses.gloss: a protective object or barrier used to block danger

definition_translations.vi_VN: khiên, tấm chắn, vật bảo vệ
definition_translations.th_TH: โล่, สิ่งป้องกัน, เกราะ

senses.gloss: to protect someone or something from harm or criticism
senses.example: The policy is designed to shield customers from unexpected fees.

example_translations.zh_TW: 這項政策旨在保護顧客免受意外費用影響。
example_translations.ja_JP: その方針は、顧客を予期しない料金から守るために設計されています。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 정책은 고객을 예상치 못한 수수료로부터 보호하기 위해 마련되었다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Chính sách này được thiết kế để bảo vệ khách hàng khỏi các khoản phí bất ngờ.
example_translations.th_TH: นโยบายนี้ออกแบบมาเพื่อปกป้องลูกค้าจากค่าธรรมเนียมที่ไม่คาดคิด

definition_translations.th_TH: ปกป้อง, ป้องกัน, บัง
